selected_experts.reason: To confirm the primary subject is correctly classified as an altar and distinguish it from general tables or shrines.
To verify the spatial relationship between the altar and the background wall/reredos, ensuring no geometric melting or impossible depth cues.
To check for boundary artifacts where the cloth meets the altar base and ensure the cloth drapes naturally without fusing into the wood.
To assess overall image coherence, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle texture anomalies or AI-generation artifacts.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the altar base
Natural draping and physics of the altar cloth
Spatial separation between altar and background reredos
Consistency of lighting and shadows on the altar surface
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the white cloth and the wooden altar base. AI often struggles with realistic cloth physics, leading to fusion or unnatural stiffening. Also, verify that the perspective lines of the altar align correctly with the floor and background architecture.
